description: B2/item16: 3D automatic cluster boxes, data box / floor grid / gizmo toggle pixel assertions.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
k = rng.integers(0, 4, 5000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (4, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (5000, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: switch to 3D and wait for layout
steps.report: { dims: a.dims, nAnchors: a.prepared.nAnchors, nKept: a.nKept }

steps.name: data box is rendered by default (non-black pixels in 3D canvas)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__px3d = n;

steps.name: hide data box and verify pixel count changes
steps.eval: a.setView({ show3DDataBox: false }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__pxNoBox = n;

steps.name: restore data box, enable floor grid and gizmo
steps.eval: a.setView({ show3DDataBox: true, show3DFloorGrid: true, show3DGizmo: true })
steps.report: { show3DDataBox: a.view.show3DDataBox, show3DFloorGrid: a.view.show3DFloorGrid, show3DGizmo: a.view.show3DGizmo }

steps.name: canvas is non-blank with floor grid and gizmo enabled
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__pxFull = n;

steps.name: enable 3D clusters
steps.eval: const s = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); s.value = 'clusters'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: enable 3D cluster boxes (show outlines)
steps.eval: const labels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')); const cb = labels.find(l => l.textContent.includes('Show outlines'))?.querySelector('input'); if (cb && !cb.checked) cb.click();

steps.name: 3D cluster boxes drawn (pixel scan after 3D boxes enabled)
steps.eval: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__px3dClusters = n;
